Chapter 4 Analysis

Get Started

Who This Is For

Undergraduate Students
Masters Students
PhD Candidates

Chapter 4 is where most students stall — the data is collected, but turning it into a coherent Results and Findings chapter that satisfies a supervisor's expectations feels impossible without statistical training.

We handle the coding, descriptive tables, hypothesis testing, and narrative write‑up, structured exactly the way your department expects — objective by objective, hypothesis by hypothesis.

What's Included

Data coding and cleaning
Descriptive statistics tables and charts
Hypothesis testing aligned to research objectives
APA/MLA formatted results narrative
Alignment check against Chapter 1 & 3
Revision support before your defense
Tools we use:SPSSSTATAExcelR

How It Works

01

Send Chapters 1–3 & Data

We review your objectives, hypotheses, and questionnaire alongside your raw dataset.

02

Coding & Analysis

Data is coded and analyzed test‑by‑test, matched to each objective or hypothesis.

03

Chapter 4 Draft

You receive a full draft with tables, figures, and narrative interpretation in your required format.

04

Revision & Defense Prep

One free revision round, plus a walkthrough so you can defend every result confidently.

Why Work With Us

Results are matched objective‑by‑objective and hypothesis‑by‑hypothesis
Formatted to your university's specific style guide
You'll understand every result well enough to defend it live
Fast turnaround for tight submission deadlines

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you write the whole chapter or just run the stats?

Both — we can run analysis only, or provide the full written Chapter 4 draft, depending on what you need.

Can you match my university's specific format?

Yes, send your department's guidelines and we'll follow them exactly.

What if my supervisor asks for changes?

One revision round is included; further revisions are billed at a reduced rate.

Can you help me prepare for my defense?

Yes, we offer a walkthrough session covering every result so you can answer panel questions confidently.
